title: Copernicus Urban Atlas, land use / land cover nomenclature
publisher: European Environment Agency (EEA), Copernicus Land Monitoring Service
version: Urban Atlas 2012, 2018 and 2021 (incl. the 2021 access classes 14110-14130 and no-data classes 91000/92000)
license_note: Codes and names from the nomenclature table of the UA 2021 Product User Manual. Colours: 2018 legend from the renderer (field code_2018) of the EEA map service UrbanAtlas/UA_UrbanAtlas_2018 (https://image.discomap.eea.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/UrbanAtlas/UA_UrbanAtlas_2018/MapServer/layers?f=pjson); access and no-data classes from the SLD of the CLMS WMS layer UA_LCU_2021_VECTOR, which repeats the 2018 colours for all shared classes.
note: Matching uses the five-digit code; the class_* columns (class names) are recognised but not used for matching. Urban fabric classes differ only by soil sealing, not by building type; all are drawn as residential_area (UA PUM: predominant residential use; INSPIRE LU guideline: HILUCS 5). 14200 is drawn as recreation_area because it mixes sports, leisure parks, campgrounds and allotments. Attribute hilucs gives the HILUCS values of the INSPIRE Land Use guideline's Urban Atlas mapping (class 1 only); ua_no is the nomenclature number; access is the 2021 access split. Entries 1, 11, 112, 12, 122, 13, 14, 2, 3, 9 are group keys (UA number without dots) for the prefix fallback. Change layers carry code_2018 and code_2021 together: pass column= explicitly. UA 2006 (field CODE2006) used a different rural nomenclature and is not covered. The Street Tree Layer is matched on its own attribute STL (1 = tree -> tree_canopy, 99 = no data); do not pass STL values as code.

entries.name: Continuous urban fabric (S.L. : > 80%)
entries.note: Predominantly residential, but also city centres and CBDs with partial residential use (UA PUM). Remap to mixed_use_area to set cores apart.

entries.name: Discontinuous very low density urban fabric (S.L. : < 10%)
Isolated structures
entries.note: Isolated structures with a residential component, e.g. single farmhouses (UA PUM).

entries.name: Industrial, commercial, public, military and private units
entries.note: Also schools, hospitals, places of worship and utilities with their lawns and parking (UA PUM); public_facility_area where known.

entries.name: Fast transit roads and associated land
entries.note: Includes verges, embankments and parallel paths.

entries.name: Other roads and associated land
entries.note: Includes verges, green strips and tree-lined alleys along the road.

entries.name: Mineral extraction and dump sites
entries.note: Merges CLC 131 and 132; dump sites -> landfill.

entries.name: Land without current use
entries.note: Brownfields and left-over land with secondary ruderal vegetation (UA PUM).

entries.name: Green urban areas
entries.note: 2006-2018 and the revised 2018 layer; split by access in 2021. Includes cemeteries and urban forests with recreational use; private gardens excluded (UA PUM).

entries.name: Green urban areas (Public access)
entries.note: 2021 only.

entries.name: Green urban areas (Private access)
entries.note: 2021 only. Not public; drawn as green_space, access kept in attribute access.

entries.name: Green urban areas (Unknown access conditions)
entries.note: 2021 only.

entries.name: Sports and leisure facilities
entries.note: Also sports fields, golf courses, allotment gardens, campgrounds, leisure and amusement parks, marinas (UA PUM). sports_ground for plain sports sites; the INSPIRE LU guideline maps the class to 3_4_3 SportsInfrastructure.

entries.name: Permanent crops (vineyards, fruit trees, olive groves)
entries.note: Vineyards -> vineyard.

entries.name: Orchards
entries.note: Legacy entry: only in the legend of the older EEA service UA_UrbanAtlas_2018, not in the manuals' nomenclature.

entries.name: Forests
entries.note: Tree cover > 30 %, height > 5 m, incl. transitional woodland and clear cuts; urban forests with recreational use are 14100.

entries.name: Herbaceous vegetation associations (natural grassland, moors…)
entries.note: Natural grassland, scrub, moors and abandoned land under natural colonisation.

entries.name: Open spaces with little or no vegetation (beaches, dunes, bare rocks, glaciers)
entries.note: Beaches, dunes, river gravel, bare rock, sparse vegetation, burnt areas, snow and ice.

entries.name: Wetlands
entries.note: Inland and coastal wetlands incl. sedge beds and peat bogs.

entries.name: Water
entries.note: Rivers and canals -> watercourse.
